_comment: Single source of truth for all MCC parameters. Drives CLI, validation, prompts, widget, and tests.

deploymentTarget.description: Deployment target (managed-inference, async-inference, batch-transform, hyperpod-eks, eks)

icGpuCount.description: GPUs allocated to the inference component

icMemorySize.description: Memory in MB for the inference component

maxLoras.description: Maximum concurrent LoRA adapters in GPU memory

includeBenchmark.description: Include SageMaker AI Benchmarking scripts (do/benchmark, do/optimize). Workload configuration is specified at runtime via --workload flag.

benchmarkRequestCount.description: Total number of benchmark requests to send

benchmarkS3OutputPath.description: S3 URI for benchmark results output

skipPrompts.description: Skip interactive prompts and use configuration from other sources

autoPrompt.description: Fill defaults, prompt only for missing required values

force.description: Overwrite existing output directory without prompting

noBuild.description: Use stock DLC image directly — skip Dockerfile/build/push generation

modelFormat.description: Model serialization format (pkl, joblib, json, model, ubj, keras, h5, SavedModel)

roleArn.description: IAM role ARN for SageMaker execution

hfToken.description: HuggingFace token (or $HF_TOKEN for env var reference)

hfTokenArn.description: HuggingFace token ARN from Secrets Manager

ngcToken.description: NVIDIA NGC token (or $NGC_API_KEY for env var reference)

ngcTokenArn.description: NVIDIA NGC token ARN from Secrets Manager

endpointInitialInstanceCount.description: Number of instances for the endpoint

endpointVolumeSize.description: ML storage volume size in GB

capacityReservationArn.description: Capacity reservation ARN (FTP or ODCR) for reserved instance deployment

icCpuCount.description: vCPUs allocated to the inference component

asyncS3OutputPath.description: S3 output path for async results

prompt.message: S3 output path for async results?

asyncSnsSuccessTopic.description: SNS topic ARN for success notifications

asyncSnsErrorTopic.description: SNS topic ARN for error notifications

batchInputPath.description: S3 input path for batch data

batchOutputPath.description: S3 output path for batch results

batchSplitType.description: Input split type: Line, RecordIO, None

hpGpuCount.description: Number of GPUs to request per pod (sets nvidia.com/gpu and VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE)

hpNodeSelector.description: Instance type for Kubernetes nodeSelector (e.g. ml.g5.12xlarge)

hpEfaEnabled.description: Enable EFA device requests for NCCL optimization (true/false)

hpMemRequest.description: Override memory request (e.g. '64Gi'). If empty, auto-scales 16Gi per GPU.

hpCpuRequest.description: Override CPU request (e.g. '16'). If empty, auto-scales 4 CPU per GPU.

hpQueue.description: Kueue queue name or PriorityClass for fair scheduling

icEnv.description: Deploy-time environment variable for inference components (IC_ENV_* prefix), repeatable (e.g. VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN=8192)

engineFeature.description: Enable an engine-specific feature declared in the selected engine's serve plugin (engine_features). Form NAME=VALUE, repeatable (e.g. radix_attention=true for SGLang, rolling_batch_backend=vllm for LMI). Resolved to the engine's real env var and validated against the manifest.

smart.description: Enable smart mode (live AWS API calls for MCP servers)

discover.description: Enable discovery mode for MCP servers

offline.description: Run in offline mode (no network calls)

doConfig._comment: do/config <-> parameter mapping (Wave 8 / OQ-8.6). Every export in templates/do/config is user input (a parameter carries it as doConfigVar), runtime-owned (the RUNTIME_OWNED_VARS sources regenerate uses: targets.d runtime_owned_vars + serve.d dimension_map + SHARED_RUNTIME_VARS), a secret (a sensitive parameter; exported as a $VAR reference only) or derived (listed here with the reason it is excluded). Enforced by test/unit/do-config-schema-mapping.test.js.

derived.MCC_VERSION: generator version stamp written at generation time
derived.DEPLOY_MODE: set to dlc-direct by --no-build (generation-time image-mode decision, not a do/config input)
derived.CONTAINER_IMAGE_URI: DLC image resolved at generation time for dlc-direct mode
derived.ENDPOINT_EXTERNAL: computed from an imported existing endpoint (mcc import), no generator parameter
derived.INSTANCE_POOLS: heterogeneous pools resolved by the instance recommender, no generator parameter
derived.INFERENCE_AMI_VERSION: resolved at deploy time from the instance family (fleet-drivers.json AWS AMI table, BL209) and the image default; no generator parameter
derived.IC_ENV_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN: computed by the instance sizer (sizerMaxModelLen), default 4096
derived.IC_ENV_VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION: commented example of a deploy-time IC env var (set via --ic-env)
derived.HF_MODEL_ID: copy of modelName preserved for tokenizer / catalog lookups after staging
derived.TUNE_SUPPORTED: computed from the tune catalog for the model
derived.TUNE_MODEL_ID: resolved from the tune catalog (JumpStart hub id), no generator parameter
derived.MLFLOW_APP_ARN: resolved from the bootstrap profile by do/lib/profile.sh (BL163)
derived.HF_TOKEN_ARN: resolved from the bootstrap profile secrets at run time (BL076); commented manual-override slot
derived.NGC_API_KEY_ARN: resolved from the bootstrap profile secrets at run time (BL076); commented manual-override slot
derived._MLCC_CONFIG_PRINTED: print-once guard for the configuration summary

derivedDynamic.orderedEnvVars: catalog env vars merged with the model-env / server-env / engine-feature values; the per-family key lists (MLCC_*_ENV_KEYS) carry the user inputs
